note: List prices in USD per million tokens at the standard tier, used only to estimate build cost when a CLI reports tokens but not cost (Codex, agy). OpenAI's are its short-context rates (at most 272K input tokens per request); builds stay well under that. Cache writes are priced at OpenAI's 30-minute rate. Google's are the Gemini API rates in force on the date given: they double from 2026-12-01 (Argon) and 2027-01-01 (3.8 Flash), and builds made after that need the new rates. Add a model as { "inputPerM": 0, "cachedInputPerM": 0, "cacheWritePerM": 0, "outputPerM": 0, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "source": "<price page>" }, keyed by its models.json id.
